instruction: Candid office photograph, medium shot. In an office meeting room, the man with glasses in a white shirt (R3) on the left and the woman in a black blazer (R2) on the right high-five. The woman (R2) laughs joyfully with her mouth open as her right hand meets the man's (R3) raised hand in the foreground. In the background between them, the woman in a light blue shirt (R1) stands smiling and watching the interaction. Bright, natural indoor light fills the room, highlighting the clean white walls.
